newsitem.title: USA: Vertex in Phase II breast cancer trial.
newsitem.headline: Vertex in Phase II breast cancer trial.

text.p: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that it and BioChem Pharma have started Phase II clinical trials of VX-710 for breast cancer and soft tissue sarcoma.
Vertex is developing VX-710 to resensitize tumor cells to treatment with chemotherapeutic agents in patients with cancer complicated by multidrug resistance.
The company said that multidrug resistance significantly limits the efficacy of many cancer chemotherapy regimens and is a major factor in the failure of cancer chemotherapy.
BioChem is Vertex's partner for the development and marketing of VX-710 in Canada.
The start of the clinical trials in breast cancer and soft tissue sarcoma follows a Phase II clinical trial of VX-710 in patients with liver cancer that Vertex began in mid-1996.
